manifesto-1.label: Manifesto
lines: Stoicism for people who feel things.
Modern Stoic practice, explained through psychology: how to regulate, decide and act when emotions are loud.

manifesto-2.label: Manifesto
lines: “Let not the eyes be dry when we have lost a friend, nor let them overflow. We may weep, but we must not wail.”
Feel it fully. Then choose what you do next.

manifesto-3.label: Manifesto
lines: 1. Every quote cites its book and section, in a public-domain translation. If it is our wording, it says Moodius.
2. No statues, no gold, no marble. Just the ideas, and what to do with them.

manifesto-4.label: Manifesto
lines: 7 Stoic tools for when emotions are loud. One tool a day for a week. Free.
Daily carousel at 12:00, reel at 18:00. Journal question every night at 21:00.
